pages.title: Provider Adapters
pages.purpose: Index of the adapter layer, HTTP resilience patterns, and the child pages for provider-specific integrations.

page_notes.content: Canonical anchors: docs/00-project/RULES.md, docs/02-architecture/decisions/, tests/architecture/, src/bioetl/.

pages.title: HTTP Client
pages.purpose: Documents the UnifiedHTTPClient, circuit breaker (CLOSED/OPEN/HALF_OPEN states), token-bucket rate limiter, retry mixin, and the ErrorService taxonomy. Explains how adapters share these cross-cutting concerns.

pages.title: Unified Client
pages.purpose: Describes the shared HTTP client abstraction, request lifecycle, and the policy surface that adapters must use instead of ad hoc transport code.

pages.title: Retry Policy
pages.purpose: Explains circuit-breaker transitions, retry semantics, and the failure modes that adapters inherit from the shared resilience layer.

pages.title: Rate Limiter
pages.purpose: Documents rate limiting, backoff behavior, and the transport policy that keeps provider access stable and predictable under load.
